C0024.title: Shanghai Police Dismantle Criminal Gang Using Automated Software to Scalp and Resell Medical Appointments
C0024.summary: The Minhang branch of the Shanghai Public Security Bureau dismantled a criminal gang involved in automated appointment scalping, hoarding, reselling, and patient referral services, arresting 10 suspects at once; Li, Zheng and others were criminally detained, and 4 'patient escorts' were administratively detained. The gang controlled over 4,000 accounts that frequently changed patient information and made over 3,000 appointments. Li used script software and auto-clickers to monitor slot availability and manually grab appointments, illegally profiting over 2.4 million yuan; Zheng commissioned others to develop an app and used scripts and virtual machines for automated grabbing, completing each in just 1 second, with total illicit gains of over 3.1 million yua

references.title: Shanghai tertiary hospital reported to police; Li, Zheng and others criminally detained, 4 'patient escorts' arrested
